# 🎓 Student Management System

> **A Complete Web-Based System Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python** 🚀  
> *Developed by Phyline | Nairobi, Kenya 🇰🇪*

---

## 📌 About The Project
This is a fully functional **Student Management System** designed to help schools, colleges and learning institutions manage student records efficiently.  
It is built as a full-stack application — combining a beautiful Frontend with a powerful Python Backend.

This project demonstrates my skills in:
✅ **HTML5** — Structure & Semantics  
✅ **CSS3** — Modern Design & Responsiveness  
✅ **JavaScript** — Logic, DOM Manipulation & API Integration  
✅ **Python** — Backend Development, Data Handling & Server Management  
✅ **JSON** — Permanent Data Storage  

🔗 **Repository Link:** [https://github.com/silversterling682-hash/Student-Management-System](https://github.com/silversterling682-hash/Student-Management-System)

---

## ✨ Core Features
### 📋 Student Records
- ➕ **Add New Students** — Capture full details including name, admission number, class, age, gender, contact and location
- 👁️ **View All Students** — Clear table layout showing all records at a glance
- ✏️ **Update Details** — Edit any information if changes occur
- ❌ **Delete Records** — Remove students safely with confirmation prompt

### 📊 Statistics & Analytics
- 📈 **Real-Time Dashboard** — Shows total students, number of boys, girls and number of classes
- 📉 **Live Updates** — Statistics change automatically when you add/remove students

### 🔍 Advanced Tools
- 🔎 **Smart Search** — Find any student instantly by Name, Admission Number or Class
- 💾 **Auto-Save** — All data is stored permanently in a database file
- 📱 **Responsive Design** — Works perfectly on **Mobile 📱, Tablet 💻 and PC 🖥️**
